overview: Indexes two November 1940 notes: ITT's Japan bond-return request, and a reported Shanghai telephone rate increase.

people.name: Mackay
people.role: Official in the U.S. Department of State’s Far Eastern affairs office (FE)

people.name: Frank C. Page
people.role: International Telephone and Telegraph Corporation representative who telephoned the Department of State

subfiles.title: List of Papers concerning telephone affairs in Japan
subfiles.about: An index sheet describes two November 29, 1940 notes concerning the return of Japanese corporate bonds and an increase in Shanghai telephone rates.
subfiles.summary: Indexes Page's call on ITT's Japan bond-return request and a note on increased Shanghai telephone rates, both November 1940.

interest: Tracks 1940 ITT bonds and Shanghai telephone-rate records.
